To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the biological activity of the β-lacatam antibiotics can be correlated with certain aspects of the molecular electronic structure of the molecule, and the correlation is best for the cephalosponin C derivatives.
the biological activity of a series of cephalosprin C derivatives is correlated with the electron population at the carbonyl-carbon and the bond strength of the carbonyloxy bond.

the biological activity of the cephalosparin C series of compounds is correlated with the electron populations of the carbons of the β-lacatam ring and the bond strength indices of the bonds of the carbonyls.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a quantitative structure-activity relationship for a series of cephalosprin derivatives, using two different methods of calculating molecular orbital parameters, extended Hückel and CNDO/ 2.
the application of theoretical methods to the study of the structure-activity relationships of antibiotics and other drugs.
the development of molecular orbital methods which can be used to study the electronic structure of complex molecules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the more electropositive the β-lactams, the more active are the cephalos- porins.
the greater the electron deficiency of the β-lac-tam ring carbonyl carbon, the greater the biological activity of a cephalosporine derivative.

the greater the electron population of the carbonylic carbon, and the greater the bond strength index of the carbonylc oxygen-carbon bond, the lower the biological activity of the cephalosorin derivative.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the biological activity of the cephalosparin derivatives is related to the electronic structure of β-lactam carbonyl group.
a cephalosporan with a β-lactam carbonyl carbon with the largest electron population and a carbonyl carbon bond order of 1.00 will have the highest biological activity.
the biological activity of a cephalosporine is directly related to its ability to donate electrons into the carbonyl group of the β-lactic acid ring.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electronic structure of a molecule can be correlated with biological activity.
the electronic structure of a cephalosporine is an important factor in determining its biological activity.
the carbonyl oxygen is a key site in the β-lactams.
